dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: ご相談をはじめる前に、性別と年齢、あと何とお呼びすればいいか教えていただけますか？あだ名でも大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Before we start the consultation, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you would like me to call you? A nickname is fine too.

dialogue.content: 28歳男です
dialogue.English: I'm a 28-year-old man.

dialogue.content: 柳田とお呼びください
dialogue.English: Please call me Yanagida.

dialogue.content: 柳田さんですね、教えていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Mr. Yanagida, thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでは、本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, what would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 介護職に従事していまして、コロナに不安を感じます
dialogue.English: I work as a caregiver, and I'm feeling anxious about COVID-19.

dialogue.content: 漠然としていますが
dialogue.English: It's a bit vague, though.

dialogue.content: ええ、コロナ…本当に不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, COVID-19... it really does make you anxious, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: No, no, that's perfectly fine.

dialogue.content: いつ脅威がやってくるのかと恐れています
dialogue.English: I’m scared, wondering when the threat might strike.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、怖く感じますよね…
dialogue.English: I understand—it does feel scary, doesn’t it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 日常生活で常に不安な感じですか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel anxious all the time in your daily life?

dialogue.content: 仕事のことを考えると不安ですね…
dialogue.English: I feel anxious when I think about work...

dialogue.content: なるほど、お仕事には影響しますものね
dialogue.English: I see, it does affect your work, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お仕事に関して、コロナがどのような影響で不安を感じますか？
dialogue.English: Regarding your work, in what ways does COVID-19 make you feel anxious?

dialogue.content: 私と同じ介護職の友人は、クラスターが発生し大変な目に遭ったと言ってました。
dialogue.English: A friend of mine who is also a caregiver said a cluster broke out at their workplace, and they went through a very hard time.

dialogue.content: なんと……
dialogue.English: My goodness...

dialogue.content: それはとても怖いですね
dialogue.English: That must be really scary.

dialogue.content: ご友人は大丈夫だったんですか？
dialogue.English: Was your friend okay?

dialogue.content: はい職場の雰囲気は笑顔が少なく静まりかえってます
dialogue.English: Yes, the atmosphere at the workplace is subdued, with few smiles.

dialogue.content: 友人だけ罹らなかったそうです
dialogue.English: Apparently, only my friend didn't get infected.

dialogue.content: ご友人は無事だったのですね、それはよかったです
dialogue.English: So your friend was safe. I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: はい、私も安心しました
dialogue.English: Yes, I was relieved too.

dialogue.content: そうですね…自分の職場にもクラスター感染するかもしれないと思うと…不安がつのるばかりですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine... The thought that a cluster infection could happen at your own workplace... the anxiety must just keep building up.

dialogue.content: そうですね…そのことをどうしても考えてしまうので…
dialogue.English: Yes... I just can’t help thinking about it...

dialogue.content: ええ、現状を見れば考えてしまうのは当然だと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, given the current situation, it’s only natural to think that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 柳田さんは、コロナに関してどのように感じておられますか？
dialogue.English: Mr. Yanagida, could you tell me more about your feelings regarding the COVID situation?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: 不安が少なくなれば良いと思います。
dialogue.English: I wish my anxiety would lessen.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、そうなれば気持ちが楽になりますものね
dialogue.English: I agree. You'd feel more at ease if that happened, wouldn't you?

dialogue.content: もっと対策や知識が備わってれば、少しは解消するのかな？と思ったりします
dialogue.English: I wonder if having more knowledge and countermeasures would help alleviate it a bit.

dialogue.content: そうですね、たしかにおっしゃるとおりだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think you're absolutely right.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 対策方法や知識があれば、不安はなくなっていく、という感じですよね
dialogue.English: So, it feels like having countermeasures and knowledge would make the anxiety fade, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: ただ不安がるだけでなく、もっと具体的に取り組めればと思います
dialogue.English: Rather than just being anxious, I'd like to take more concrete steps.

dialogue.content: あとは
dialogue.English: Also...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Go on.

dialogue.content: 最近地震も多いのが気になります…
dialogue.English: I’m also concerned that there have been many earthquakes lately...

dialogue.content: ああ、そうですね…先日東北で大きな地震がありましたよね
dialogue.English: Ah, yes... there was a large earthquake in the Tohoku region recently, wasn't there?

dialogue.content: 地震があったときどうされてましたか？
dialogue.English: What were you doing when the earthquake happened?

dialogue.content: はいこちらは震度5弱でした
dialogue.English: Yes, it was a 5-lower on the seismic intensity scale here.

dialogue.content: その日は休日で家にいました
dialogue.English: It was my day off, so I was at home.

dialogue.content: ええ！？それは怖かったですよね…大丈夫だったのですか？？
dialogue.English: What!? That must have been terrifying... Were you alright?

dialogue.content: ものが倒れたとかは職場も家もなかったですが、
dialogue.English: Nothing fell over at work or at home, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 揺れが大きかったことで、不安が募りました
dialogue.English: ...the strong shaking made my anxiety worse.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…地震は自分ではとめることができないし、怖い限りですよね
dialogue.English: I understand... You can't stop an earthquake yourself, so it's just terrifying.

dialogue.content: そうですね、いつくるかわからないので余計脅威に感じます
dialogue.English: That’s right. Not knowing when it will come makes it feel all the more threatening.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナや地震、天災などの「自分ではどうやっても解消できないもの」はとても怖く感じると私も思います
dialogue.English: I also think that things you can't control, like COVID, earthquakes, and other natural disasters, can feel very frightening.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: これらはいろんな対処法を知っておくのが一番だと思います
dialogue.English: For these things, I believe the best approach is to know various coping strategies.

dialogue.content: 柳田さんはコロナに関して、どのような対策を講じられておられますか？
dialogue.English: Mr. Yanagida, what kinds of measures are you taking regarding COVID?

dialogue.content: マスク、手洗いうがい、アルコール消毒、換気は家でも職場でもやっています
dialogue.English: I wear a mask, wash my hands, gargle, use alcohol sanitizer, and ensure ventilation both at home and at work.

dialogue.content: 素晴らしいですね！
dialogue.English: That’s wonderful!

dialogue.content: いえ、職場に迷惑はかけてられませんので
dialogue.English: Well, I can't cause trouble for my workplace.

dialogue.content: とても意識を高くもっておられるのですね
dialogue.English: You’re very conscientious.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、自分だけのことではないですものね
dialogue.English: That's right, it's not just about you, is it?

dialogue.content: 地震に関しての対策は、如何ですか？
dialogue.English: And what about your preparations for earthquakes?

dialogue.content: 幸いにも体調を崩すことはないので、コロナ対策は引き続き頑張りたいと思います
dialogue.English: Fortunately, I haven't gotten sick, so I want to continue doing my best with the COVID measures.

dialogue.content: 地震は先生の仰る通りだと思いました
dialogue.English: Regarding earthquakes, I realized you were right.

dialogue.content: 対策ができていない自信のなさが不安を大きくしてる、と思いました
dialogue.English: I realized that my lack of confidence from not being prepared is making my anxiety worse.

dialogue.content: それはありがとうございます、恐縮です
dialogue.English: Thank you for saying that; I’m humbled.

dialogue.content: なるほどなるほど、素晴らしい気付きですね！
dialogue.English: I see, I see—that’s a wonderful insight!

dialogue.content: いえ、まだ行動に移せてないのでこれからですね
dialogue.English: Well, I haven't taken any action yet, so that's the next step.

dialogue.content: ええ、行動を一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Yes, let's think about what actions you can take together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: コロナに関する対策を考える上で、便利なツールがあるのですがお伝えしてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: When considering measures for COVID, there’s a useful tool—may I share it with you?

dialogue.content: はいお願いいたします！
dialogue.English: Yes, please!

dialogue.content: LINEで定期的にコロナ情報を取得することができるのですが、ご存知ですか？（ご存知だったら申し訳ないです）
dialogue.English: You can get regular COVID-19 information through the LINE app. Are you aware of it? (My apologies if you already know.)

dialogue.content: いいえ、存じませんまでした
dialogue.English: No, I wasn’t aware of that.

dialogue.content: 「新型コロナパーソナルサポート」でLINE内で検索いただくと
dialogue.English: If you search for "COVID-19 Personal Support" within LINE...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: お住まいの自治体に合わせたチャンネルが登録できると思います
dialogue.English: I believe you can subscribe to a channel tailored to your local municipality.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！
dialogue.English: Oh, really!

dialogue.content: 初めて知りました
dialogue.English: This is the first I've heard of it.

dialogue.content: このチャンネルは感染数やPCR検査ができる病院など
dialogue.English: This channel provides information on things like infection numbers and hospitals where you can get a PCR test.

dialogue.content: いろんな情報が載っています
dialogue.English: It has a lot of different information.

dialogue.content: 対策を講じる材料になると思います
dialogue.English: I think it can be a good resource for planning your measures.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: 登録して確認してみます！
dialogue.English: I’ll register and check it out!

dialogue.content: ええ、ぜひとも見てみてください
dialogue.English: Yes, please do take a look.

dialogue.content: あと、これも自治体によるのですが
dialogue.English: Also, this depends on the municipality, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナ専用の電話相談なるものがありまして
dialogue.English: ...there are dedicated phone consultation services for COVID-19.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 「もしかしたらコロナ感染したかも…」と思ったら電話できる窓口がある自治体もあります
dialogue.English: Some municipalities have a hotline you can call if you think, “I might have been infected with COVID...”

dialogue.content: 必要あらばしかるべき病院へ誘導もしてくれます
dialogue.English: If necessary, they will also guide you to the appropriate hospital.

dialogue.content: 一度役所に赴いて、お話を聞いてみるのもいいかもしれません
dialogue.English: It might be a good idea to visit your local government office and ask about it.

dialogue.content: 非常に役立ちそうです！
dialogue.English: That sounds extremely helpful!

dialogue.content: それはよかったです！
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear that!

dialogue.content: 私からのご提案は以上になります、如何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Those are all my suggestions. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい、先生のおかげで勉強になりました
dialogue.English: Yes, I've learned a lot thanks to you.

dialogue.content: 誠に恐れ入ります
dialogue.English: You're very kind.

dialogue.content: 以前より、不安も軽くなった気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like my anxiety has lessened compared to before.

dialogue.content: それはなによりです！
dialogue.English: I'm so happy to hear that!

dialogue.content: 柳田さんは自分だけでなく、職場やご友人のことも考えていらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: Mr. Yanagida, you think not only of yourself but also of your workplace and your friends.

dialogue.content: 柳田さんが行動を起こせば自分だけでなく周りの方の力にもなれると私は強く思います
dialogue.English: I strongly believe that if you take action, you can be a source of strength not just for yourself, but for those around you as well.

dialogue.content: お互い頑張って乗り越えていきましょうね
dialogue.English: Let's both do our best to get through this together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。先生のお言葉に勇気が湧きました！
dialogue.English: Thank you. Your words have given me courage!

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。それでは今回のご相談を修了してよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Shall we conclude our session for today?

dialogue.content: 失礼、終了です
dialogue.English: Excuse me, I meant conclude.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、御相談いただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for sharing your concerns with me.
